workstream: W4-2e2 — Full official ordinance/resolution archive normalization

enumerationAttempt.observation: The official archive shell is publicly reachable, but the result set is populated client-side. Non-browser text retrieval exposes the search/filter shell and Loading state rather than the archive rows.
enumerationAttempt.consequence: BetterMakati cannot truthfully freeze a complete archive total from the current text-fetch path. Search-engine indexing is not accepted as a completeness mechanism.
enumerationAttempt.rule: Do not label the local registry complete until the official archive result set can be enumerated reproducibly or an official complete export is obtained.

officialCompletenessBenchmarks.source: Makati Facts and Figures 2020 — Implementation of Local Legislature
officialCompletenessBenchmarks.office: Office of the Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlungsod
officialCompletenessBenchmarks.note: This is an official annual total, not an archive-entry export. It proves the existing 2020 seed is not a complete 2020 registry.

currentBetterMakatiSeed.source: Makati City COVID-19 Recovery Plan Annex A
currentBetterMakatiSeed.scope: COVID-19 response measures in the bounded Annex A period only

extractionRequirements: Resolve the official archive's client-side data endpoint or use a browser-capable enumerator that can traverse every result/page.
Capture raw archive identity fields before enrichment: type, official reference/document code, title, official item/document URL and any archive UUID.
Persist a dated raw snapshot so later changes can be diffed.
Deduplicate against canonical localLegislation records by exact official reference plus measure type; never by fuzzy title.
Record unresolved rows explicitly rather than dropping malformed or duplicate archive results.
Only after raw enumeration is reproducible may the snapshot claim a retrievable-entry total.

nextStep.title: Resolve and enumerate the dynamic Makati legislation archive
nextStep.stopWhen: A dated raw snapshot contains every result returned by the official archive UI, with a reproducible total and exact duplicate/unresolved dispositions.
